clinic_policy.notes: Wednesday afternoon is academic half day except night float and away rotations. Maple clinic is Tue AM/PM, Thu AM/PM, and Fri AM with one attending per half-day. Overall allocation targets are 25% Maple and 75% Cedar. Each clinic derives its half-day resident maximum from its attending count and resident-to-attending ratio. Dedicated clinic weeks and overlay half-days mix PGY1/PGY2/PGY3 across clinic days.
